# Privacy Policy

> Markdown version of <https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/privacidade>. v2.0 · updated on 8 May 2026. The text with normative value is the HTML page.

It describes how personal data are collected, used, stored, shared and protected, according to LGPD (Law 13.709/2018), the Civil Framework of the Internet (Law 12.965/2014), GDPR (EU 2016/679), CCPA/CPRA and EU AI Act (EU 2024/1689).

## 1. Summary

You collect only what is necessary, the data is not sold, and the holder can review, correct or delete whatever is on it at any time.

| What? | Why? | With whom | For how long |
|---|---|---|---|
| Name, e-mail, phone | Meet request | Nobody. | 24 months or until revocation |
| Company, billing, challenges | Evaluate application profile | Internal team only | Duration of proceedings + 12 months |
| IP, browser, viewed pages | Statistics and security | Google (GA4), AWS | Up to 14 months (analytics) / 6 months (logs) |
| Marketing cookies (optional) | Remarketing, with consent | Meta, Google Ads | Up to 90 days |

## 2. Controller

Mauricio Yokoyama Issei (LGPD, art. 5th, VI) — professional portfolio, technical content, consulting proposals, contact forms and interactive tools. Contact: mauricio@issei.com.br.

## 3. Data collected

- **Registers:** name, e-mail, phone, company, position — forms.
- **Professionals:** approximate billing, challenges, segment — application forms.
- **Behavioral:** IP, user-agent, pages, time, clicks — cookies, pixels and logs.
- **Communication:** WhatsApp or email messages.
- **Inferred:** probable segment, lead score, interests.

**Not collected:** CPF, RG, bank or payment data, biometrics, health, political opinion or any sensitive data. The site has no checkout.

## 4. Legal basis

| Purpose | LGPD | GDPR |
|---|---|---|
| Response to contact and proposals | Preliminary procedures for the contract (Art. 7, V) | Art. 6, b |
| Direct marketing and remarketing | Consent (Art. 7, I) | Art. 6, a |
| Aggregated traffic analysis | Legitimate interest with opt-out (art. 7th, IX) | Art. 6, f |
| Tax obligation | Legal obligation (Art. 7, II) | Art. 6, c |
| Access logs | Marco Civil, art. 15 | Art. 6, c |

## 5. Sharing

Data is not sold. Contracted operators: **AWS** (host S3 and CDN CloudFront), **Google** (Analytics 4, Tag Manager, Ads with consent), **Target** (Pixel, Conversions API, message with consent), **GitHub** (public `cv.json` hosting) and **WhatsApp Business** (with opt-in). Public authorities, by court order or legal request.

## 6. International transfer

Operators process data in the US and other countries, based on LGPD art. 33 and CD/ANPD Resolution 19/2024: standard contractual clauses, EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and equivalent contractual guarantees.

## 7. Retention

| Category | Time limit |
|---|---|
| Access logs (IP + timestamp) | 6 months (Marco Civil, art. 15) |
| Unconverted lead registers | 24 months or until revocation |
| Active customer accounts | Contract + 5 years |
| Analytical cookies (GA4) | Up to 14 months |
| Encrypted backups | Up to 90 days after exclusion |

After the deadline, the data are anonymous or deleted (LGPD, art. 16).

## 8. Rights of the holder

Confirmation, access, correction, anonymization/blocking/elimination, portability, information on sharing, revocation of consent, opposition to legitimate human interest and review of automated decisions (LGPD art. 18; GDPR art. 15-22). Free service in up to 15 days (LGPD) or 30 days (GDPR). California residents: the GPC signal is respected as opt-out.

## 9. Cookies

Four categories (necessary, analysis, marketing, customization), with consent banner and no cookie wall. Nominal list in [Cookie Policy](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/cookies).

## 10. IA and automated decisions

Content generated by AI is identified; personal data does not train models without explicit consent; decisions with relevant effect go through human review (LGPD, art. 20) and the holder may ask the DPO.

## 11. Security

TLS 1.3, at-rest encryption, lower privilege (IAM, MFA), OIDC in IC/CD without fixed credentials, security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options). Incidents are reported to the ANPD and to the holders in accordance with Resolution CD/ANPD 15/2024.

## 12. Children and adolescents

The site is not directed to children under 18 and does not intentionally collect data from them (LGPD art. 14).

## 13. DPO, complaints and forum

Responsible (DPO): mauricio@issei.com.br, response in up to 15 working days. Claims to ANPD (gov.br/anpd) or the data protection authority of the country of residence. Brazilian law; foro da Comarca de São Paulo/SP, except for the consumer's home forum (CDC, art. 101, I). Material changes reopen the banner and are signaled for 30 days.
